It is an exact replica of the opamp version of the Big Muff Pi, known for its vintage tone. The kit uses high-quality metal film resistors and metallized polyester film capacitors to deliver the same vintage sound but with significantly less noise than the original pedal. Despite its small size, the Li’l Beaver kit uses all through-hole components and panel mounted hardware, making it easy to assemble and install. The pedal features true bypass, ensuring that your signal remains unaffected when the pedal is turned off. There are different versions of the Li’l Beaver kit available, each with its own unique characteristics. These versions offer variations in tone and functionality, allowing you to choose the one that best suits your preferences.
